name: Cipher-Challenge Auto-Save
postAttachCommand: if [ ! -f /tmp/autosave.pid ] || ! kill -0 $(cat /tmp/autosave.pid) 2>/dev/null; then nohup bash -c 'echo $$ > /tmp/autosave.pid; BRANCH="progress-$GITHUB_USER"; git checkout -B "$BRANCH"; while true; do if [[ -n $(git status -s) ]]; then git add -A && git commit -m "progress: $(date +%H:%M:%S)" && git push -u origin "$BRANCH"; fi; sleep 300; done' >/dev/null 2>&1 & fi
